notes: Relevance is expressed against Acts, section numbers and distinctive phrases, never chunk IDs. Chunk IDs are content-addressed and change on every re-chunk, which is precisely when this set is needed.
Expected abstentions are scored alongside answerable questions. A corpus gap is not a retrieval failure, and a system that answers without a source is worse than one that declines.
Coverage for every answerable item was confirmed against the live index before the item was written, so a failure here is a retrieval failure and not a missing document.
